title: Tiny, cute telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tripod legs -->
  <rect x="46" y="65" width="8" height="26" rx="2" fill="#7a5230"/>
  <rect x="46" y="65" width="4" height="26" fill="#9c6b3f"/>
  <rect x="22" y="80" width="8" height="16" rx="2" fill="#7a5230" transform="rotate(-22 26 88)"/>
  <rect x="22" y="80" width="4" height="16" fill="#9c6b3f" transform="rotate(-22 24 88)"/>
  <rect x="70" y="80" width="8" height="16" rx="2" fill="#7a5230" transform="rotate(22 74 88)"/>
  <rect x="74" y="80" width="4" height="16" fill="#9c6b3f" transform="rotate(22 76 88)"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="94" r="4" fill="#a0784a"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="94" r="4" fill="#a0784a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="93" r="3.5" fill="#a0784a"/>
  <!-- Mount pivot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="64" r="5" fill="#4a8fd4"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="63" r="2.5" fill="#7ab8f0"/>
  <!-- Tube body -->
  <rect x="18" y="36" width="64" height="22" rx="11" fill="#d94448"/>
  <rect x="18" y="36" width="64" height="6" rx="3" fill="#f06a6a"/>
  <!-- Tube highlight -->
  <rect x="22" y="32" width="56" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ffb0b0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Eyepiece (back/left small) -->
  <rect x="10" y="42" width="12" height="10" rx="3" fill="#3a6ea5"/>
  <rect x="10" y="42" width="12" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#6baae0"/>
  <!-- Front lens end (right) -->
  <rect x="80" y="34" width="10" height="26" rx="5" fill="#3a6ea5"/>
  <ellipse cx="86" cy="47" rx="4" ry="9" fill="#8fd0ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="85" cy="44" rx="2" ry="4" fill="#d4f0ff"/>
  <!-- Finder scope -->
  <rect x="44" y="24" width="22" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#3a6ea5"/>
  <rect x="44" y="24" width="22" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#6baae0"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="27.5" r="3.5" fill="#8fd0ff"/>
  <!-- Starry sparkles -->
  <polygon points="68,14 70,19 75,19 71,22 73,27 68,24 63,27 65,22 61,19 66,19" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <polygon points="30,10 31.5,14 35.5,14 32.5,16.5 33.5,20.5 30,18 26.5,20.5 27.5,16.5 24.5,14 28.5,14" fill="#fff5a0"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="18" r="2" fill="#fff5a0"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
</svg>
